title: Mr Investing AI Review 2026: Pros, Cons & Honest Verdict
description: Mr Investing AI review: what its site claims about a $250 deposit, AI trading and a 4.6/5 rating, and what to check before you sign up.
author: Michael Brooks
excerpt: Mr Investing AI promotes AI trading with a $250 minimum and a 4.6/5 rating, but names no operator or regulator.
content:
Mr Investing AI is presented as an AI-assisted trading platform with automated trades, a demo account and a $250 starting point. Missing are the operator, the regulator and the licence number; the one performance figure is a 4.6/5 rating lacking a source.

The name suggests an AI investing tool, but the page does not describe investing products. Its table lists crypto only, while the body lists forex and equities. What the page says, and what remains unconfirmed by us, is laid out below.

Mr Investing AI at a Glance

Here is what the platform's own page states and what it leaves out.

CategoryWhat the page says
Platform typeAI-assisted trading with automatic and manual modes
Minimum deposit$250, currency not named
FeesNone stated. No schedule given
Payment methodsCards, PayPal, Skrill and bank transfer, with other options unnamed
WithdrawalsUsually within 24 hours. No limits given
SupportDescribed as 24/7, with no channels listed
Regulator or licenceNot stated
OperatorNot named

Items come from the platform's own page. We have not tested the platform.

Is Mr Investing AI Legit? What the Claims Show

Automation and signals

The page says AI and machine learning generate signals and can place trades automatically, with a manual mode for users who prefer control. Because the strategy, model and risk limits are missing, nothing on the page lets the claim be tested.

Performance and ratings

The page refers to a high success rate and notable gains from a small deposit, but gives no return figures, time period, sample size or method. The 4.6/5 score is shown without any source or count of reviews.

Asset coverage

The name suggests an AI investing tool, but the page does not describe investing products. Its table lists crypto only, while the body lists forex and equities. You cannot establish from the page which markets are on offer until you have signed up.

Costs and Minimum Deposit

The page states a $250 minimum deposit and says there are no registration, transaction or withdrawal fees. Nothing is said about spreads, payment-provider charges or a fee schedule.

A standard minimum of 250 in local money is the yardstick here: AUD 250, GBP 250 or EUR 250, by region. Confirm the exact $250 amount and its currency in the terms, since the page omits the currency.

Who Is Behind Mr Investing AI

The page names no legal entity, company number or address. Sign-up goes through coinpulse.cc, a third-party domain, and the page does not disclose any commission arrangement.

Is Mr Investing AI a Scam? Withdrawals and Complaints

Searches for Mr Investing AI often ask whether it is a scam, whether withdrawals work and whether there are complaints. Withdrawals are described as typically a day, but the page lacks any limits, timelines or complaints information.

Review independent complaint files and reviews that state their origin before you send money. Withdrawal handling is not revealed by ratings or by glowing testimonials.

Before You Register: A Short Checklist

  • Find the legal company behind Mr Investing AI and check it against your national regulator's register.
  • Obtain in writing the full cost of spreads and withdrawals.
  • Instead of a headline rating, ask for dated and verifiable performance data.
  • Use the smallest deposit you can accept losing, and start with the demo account.

Risks to Keep in Mind

The main risk is an unnamed operator, because a user has no clear party to hold to account. Conflicting claims on the page make the risk worse. The way a trade is placed matters less than the fact that it can lose.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Mr Investing AI legit?

The site makes claims about Mr Investing AI but names no operator, regulator or licence number. Use the company registry and regulator register to vet the business before you deposit.

What is the minimum deposit for Mr Investing AI?

A $250 figure appears, but the currency it is in goes unstated. Look up the amount and currency in the terms ahead of paying.

Is Mr Investing AI regulated?

Neither a regulator nor a licence is shown, and the brokers cited are unnamed. Search the register kept by your national regulator for the operating company.

Does Mr Investing AI charge fees?

The page claims there are no fees and offers no schedule for spreads, withdrawals or currency conversion. Read the full terms first.

Would automation stop me from losing money?

No. The way a trade is placed matters less than the fact that it can lose.

Our Verdict on Mr Investing AI

Mr Investing AI's page makes broad claims without naming an operator, a regulator or verifiable results. Our rating reflects these gaps. We intend to reassess the platform when its operator and claims can be established. Risk only the funds you would be fine losing.

Whatever your choice, begin with restraint
